# NNNN: Decision title

State: Draft  
Date: YYYY-MM-DD

## Situation

Describe the problem and the constraints that led to this decision.

## Decision

State what was chosen.

## Reasons

Explain why this option was chosen over the alternatives that were seriously
considered.

## Costs

Record the drawbacks, extra work, or limits introduced by the decision.

## Revisit when

List a concrete change that would make it worth reconsidering the decision.

## Replaces

Link to an older decision only when this one replaces it. Remove this section
otherwise.
